event_name.Description: Description of the corresponding onscreen stimulus

trial_type.Description: Original event_name, or BAD_Fz_header_overlap for unrecoverable source bytes.

channel.Description: Channel affected by the BAD interval; n/a for original events.

integrity_note.Description: Data integrity explanation; no lost samples are synthesized.

integrity_interval_units.Description: Units for the added BAD integrity interval only: s (seconds). Original trigger onset values and their original sample-unit metadata are preserved; they are not silently reinterpreted or corrected by this repair.
